title: test(plugin-security): the delegated-admin own-name posture "ground truth" case boots one rig per state inside a single it, times out at 5 s in the merge queue and ejects unrelated PRs
body:
domain:server#1 · os-steve · session_01ADHkmPF1skfu2kx89BEXZi

Filing gate: ④ CI node. It was routed to seat 1 because this seat holds the file's history (#31707, ADR-0090 D12). It is not a claim.
Business reason: merge-group run 42609535314 timed out at the default 5000 ms in `packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/delegated-admin-own-name-set.posture.test.ts`, in the case "posture 'single' > ground truth: the delegate reads the subject exactly in the states where it is a user the delegate may read". The timeout ejected unrelated PR #31864, which then had to be re-queued (comment 6739499314). One slow case costs every PR batched with it, across every seat.
Reader: seat `domain:server#1`.
Dedupe: no open or closed card names this file's ground-truth case. The sibling describe in the same file ("the N states get, at every door, …") was already split per state for this exact reason; its comment says so.
class: b · type: Bug (test)
Grade: p1. A merge-queue ejection hits every lane.

## 维护者速读

合并队列里有一个测试在一个用例里为每种状态各启动一套环境，负载高时超过 5 秒就超时，把不相关的 PR 一起踢出队列。这张卡把它拆成每种状态一个用例，不靠加长超时。

## What to build

- Split the ground-truth `it` into one `it` per state (`it.each` over `[...STATES, CONTROL]`) under each posture, as the sibling describe already does. Each state gets its own time budget and its own failure line. The assertion per state stays byte-identical in meaning.
- ⛔ Raising the timeout is not the fix. Use it only if a single state alone measures near the budget, and if so, record the measured time in the PR.
- Scan the rest of the file, and the other `*.posture.test.ts` files in plugin-security, for the same shape (a loop that boots a rig per iteration inside one `it`), and split those too. List each one in the PR.

## Acceptance

- The file's case count goes up; no assertion is weakened or removed. Show it with a before/after list of assertion targets.
- The plugin-security suite is green. Give per-case timings for the split cases on a local run.
- `Clause-②: yes` (no contract change), `Metadata-protocol: none`, `skip-changeset` (test only).
